arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Aim: even effort, pod ~190 W (pod CP 185 W + 20 kJ reserve spread over ~43 min; boat CP 111 W). Heart rate is compressed for this paddler (flat 172-173 bpm above 60 % of CP) so it cannot judge effort near threshold: use pod power, boat-model power and GPS speed. Let the start settle, then hold ~190 W pod. Watch for: weed on rudder (sudden speed drop at same pod power -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power rises vs boat power with GPS speed unchanged -> set pod_gain), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shift. Consider a CP check mid-race only if evidence says the test was off (12-min test power was flat 207-217 W, no fade). Final sprint (finish) about 600-800 m out, sized by reserve left.

Hypotheses: (a) wind/current push increased (wind shift) -> next back leg GPS ~2.97; (b) pod reads low + paddler pushing harder (true ~230 W) -> back leg GPS ~3.31. HR flat 176.5 through the change, rate flat 63, paddler RPE fell 4->3 (plenty): favours (a). Pod reserve 40% at 199 W, model sustainable 190; test_cost: -5% for 5 min costs 0-2.5 s. Decide ease after back-leg check.

arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs out, even legs back; the finish leg 8 is back). Pod CP 185 W (belief 170-200), reserve 20 kJ; pod-model sustainable ~189 W. HR compressed: useless above 60% CP. WIND SHIFT at ~630 s: push of wind/current now ~0.3 m/s along the course: out legs tailwind (GPS ~3.55 at 196 W), back legs headwind (GPS ~2.9). Plan: hold own effort (~195 W) on headwind (back) legs; on tailwind (out) legs ease ~7% with a timed piece at each turn (leg 5 at 4000 m left, leg 7 at 2000 m left) - saves reserve where it costs least time. Paddler RPE 3-4/10 says plenty: if pod reserve gets low with no distress, raise CP belief. Finish sprint into the headwind on leg 8, from ~600-700 m left, sized by reserve. Watches: weed_drop (within-leg drop -> clear_rudder), reserve_very_low.

16 min: back leg 4 GPS ~2.89 at 195 W -> wind shift confirmed (push out +0.28, back -0.36; maybe also ~1% drag/share loss). Pod drift rejected. Pod reserve 34%, sustainable 189.5 W vs paddler 195 W. Removed drag_jump watch (fires on every back leg because push_along lags); added weed_drop (within-leg 60 s drop).

HR at ceiling (12-min test at 115% CP showed flat 177) so HR cannot settle it. Robust plan: tailwind legs ~180 W, headwind legs ~195 W (time-weighted avg 188 = sustainable at CP 185; more effort where the headwind makes it pay). Leftover reserve, if CP is higher, goes into a long finish push on headwind leg 8.
